facts.text: American Flag was deployed at Taurus-Littrow during Apollo 17 in 1972.
The last flag planted on the Moon. Cernan's final words on the surface: 'We leave as we came and, God willing, as we shall return, with peace and hope for all mankind.'
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Documented the final moments of human presence on the Moon; the flag deployment photographs provide the last visual record of crewed activity on the lunar surface.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Taurus-Littrow.
LROC images from 2011 show the Apollo 17 flag is still standing, casting a clear shadow — the last flag planted on the Moon by human hands.
